ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with localized high-intensity (white) markings; estimated 1:10 ratio of white-to-black pixels on the fluke itself.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark pigmentation field; high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered white focal points and linear streaks distributed across the medial and lateral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; internal angle estimated at approximately 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary featuring high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory fitted to both lobes, showing a progressive increase in slope magnitude moving outward from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several circular and ring-like high-contrast white pixel clusters; prominent examples located in the central-medial region and the lower-left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks); high-density intersections on the left lobe and elongated parallel streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring across both lobes characterized by a high frequency of intersecting white linear marks and distinct circular depigmentation spots.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast texture created by the dense accumulation of white rake marks against the uniform dark base pigmentation.
